Extract forward-looking statements by MANAGEMENT that contain a number, a range or a date: growth targets, margin bands, capex, capacity, store/plant counts, debt, launch timelines, aspirations ('we aim for 16-17%'). Put operating outcomes (revenue/volume growth, EBITDA or operating margin, profit) FIRST, then everything else. Ignore analyst questions, past results and vague optimism without numbers. Each item must quote management verbatim (max 30 words) and name the chunk id it came from.
